name: 预测分析模型训练 - 供应链 (20N)
name_en: Predictive Analytics Model Training – Supply Chain (20N)
description_en_html:
Overview

With this scope item, the customers can utilize the embedded predictive analytics functionality in the supply chain scenarios – produce, manufacturing, inventory management, logistics execution etc. It includes parameter selection in predictive model training and activation. Currently the following use case leverage the embedded predictive modeling.

Track materials in transit/open stock transport orders for which no goods receipt has been posted by the receiving plant yet which have already exceeded the estimated time in transit.

Key Process Flow

  • Train a predictive model for stock in transit with available data
  • Update the forecasted date column which shows the predicted delivery date by leveraging the embedded predictive model
  • Update to the Stock in transit process, stock transport order process with predictions

Business Benefits

  • Out of the box predictive model that can be leveraged in the stock in transit app
  • Get a predicted date for the stock in transit based on the delivery data for the customer
  • Adjust time schedule based on empirical data
  • Overall more reliable planning / scheduling of goods in transit process
description_zh_html:
概览

通过此范围项目，客户可以在供应链场景中利用嵌入式预测分析功能 - 生产、制造、库存管理、物流执行等。其中包括预测模型训练和激活中的参数选择。目前，以下用例利用嵌入式预测建模。

跟踪收货工厂尚未过账收货但已超过预计在途时间的在途物料/未清库存调拨单。

关键流程流

  • 使用可用数据训练在途库存的预测模型。
  • 利用嵌入式预测模型，更新显示预测交货日期的预测日期列
  • 使用预测更新在途库存流程、库存调拨单流程

业务优势

  • 现成的预测模型，可在在途库存应用中使用
  • 根据客户的交货数据，获取在途库存的预测日期
  • 根据经验数据调整时间表
  • 总体上更可靠地计划/安排在途货物流程
